label: WhatsApp
description: Official personal WhatsApp integration with explicit per-account read-only or read/write access.

apps.label: Personal WhatsApp
apps.description: Link your own WhatsApp account for private read and send tools, isolated from the agent-facing messaging bridge.

connectPrompt: Link your personal WhatsApp account here to give the AI private read tools, send tools, or both. This connection is isolated from the separate messaging-platform WhatsApp bridge.

tools.name: whatsapp_personal_get_profile
tools.description: Get metadata about the linked personal WhatsApp account and its current sync state. When multiple personal WhatsApp accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

connection_id.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp account ID.

account_email.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp phone number identifier.

tools.name: whatsapp_personal_list_chats
tools.description: List cached chats synchronized for the linked personal WhatsApp account. When multiple personal WhatsApp accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

connection_id.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp account ID.

account_email.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp phone number identifier.

tools.name: whatsapp_personal_get_messages
tools.description: Read recent cached messages from a linked personal WhatsApp chat. When multiple personal WhatsApp accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

chat_id.description: WhatsApp JID or phone number for the chat to inspect.

connection_id.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp account ID.

account_email.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp phone number identifier.

tools.name: whatsapp_personal_send_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message from the linked personal account. When multiple personal WhatsApp accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which one to use.

to.description: Recipient WhatsApp JID or phone number.

connection_id.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp account ID.

account_email.description: Optional connected personal WhatsApp phone number identifier.
